desc:
Welcome to Steal A Slime!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal steamers from slimes
🐣 Hatch steamers to collect rare slimes
💸 Earn money from your slimes
🏃‍♂️ Train on the treadmill to gain speed
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🥷 Steal steamers from other players
💫 Discover rare steamers, slimes, sizes, and mutations

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet Players
